scope: Read-only source-driven interior DTM bank candidate; all parameters frozen before computation in interior-bank-method.json. Camera-only ablation with the original frozen camera profile; no fit, GPS, station, track surface or vehicle height changes. NOT adopted.

legacyBakeReproduction.method: Exact default legacy bake geometry and bilinear convention on current licensed terrain; 20m circular moving mean and0.08 clamp.

limits: The candidate has not passed full road-surface/vehicle consistency checks; camera-only replacement does not make a coherent road model.
Fixed original mount roll was calibrated conditional on the original bank; its parameters may absorb some bank bias. No new global refit was performed.
DTM and raw pavement trace are not independent surveyed ground truth.
1m grid cannot characterize narrow paint/curb structure or suspension body roll.
Source-derived slope sensitivity is reported rather than choosing a parameter set that improves video metrics.
